dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Amazing! It's my favorite national park now.
dialogue.reading: əˈmeɪzɪŋ! ɪts maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈnæʃənəl ˈpɑːrk ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! On the first day, I saw a deer drinking at the river.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ɑːn ðə ˈfɜːrst ˈdeɪ, aɪ ˈsɔː ə ˈdɪr ˈdrɪŋkɪŋ ət ðə ˈrɪvər.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Wow! Did you see any monkeys?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ! dɪd juː ˈsiː ˈɛni ˈmʌŋkiz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Lots! We watched some monkeys climbing a tree near the trail.
dialogue.reading: ˈlɑːts! wiː ˈwɑːtʃt sʌm ˈmʌŋkiz ˈklaɪmɪŋ ə ˈtriː ˈnɪr ðə ˈtreɪl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: A little. One night, I heard something walking outside our room.
dialogue.reading: ə ˈlɪtəl. ˈwʌn ˈnaɪt, aɪ ˈhɜːrd ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈwɔːkɪŋ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd aʊər ˈruːm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Just a deer! And every morning, I heard birds singing everywhere.
dialogue.reading: dʒʌst ə ˈdɪr! ənd ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, aɪ ˈhɜːrd ˈbɜːrdz ˈsɪŋɪŋ ˈɛvriwɛr.
